# Paths whose change makes a pull request a breakpoint. One glob per line.
# A pull request that touches any of these gets the deep Codex review in
# CI, at high effort, and the merge waits on it. Everything else gets the
# cloud integration's review on the subscription and a human read.
# Syntax: ** matches any depth, * matches within one segment.
